advice.above_ceiling: You passed the healthy ceiling of {ceiling}%. Holding it saves about {saving}% of capacity per year at your usage.
advice.battery_not_reporting: A battery is present but reports no valid values (zero charge, zero voltage). No charge-level alert can be trusted right now, and the cells or the embedded controller are the likely cause. Open diagnostics to see exactly what was read.
advice.critical_low: Charge is {percent}% on battery power. Connect mains now; discharging below this point adds permanent wear.
advice.deep_discharge: Charge is {percent}%. Deep discharge cuts expected cycles to roughly {cycles} against thousands for shallow ones.
advice.deep_discharge_eta: Charge is {percent}%, and at the current rate about {minutes} minutes remain to 10%. Deep discharge cuts expected cycles to roughly {cycles}.
advice.elevated_temp: Battery temperature is {temp}°C. Above 30°C wear accelerates about {multiplier} times; lift the machine off the surface and cut the load.
advice.enable_control: Your machine can enforce charge limits. Setting {floor}% to {ceiling}% saves about {saving}% of capacity per year.
advice.end_of_life: Present capacity is {soh}% of design, at the conventional end-of-life mark ({eol}%). Time estimates get less accurate from here.
advice.full_charge_dwell: Sitting at full charge costs about {loss}% of capacity per year against {best}% at 40%. Unplug or set a ceiling.
advice.health_strong: Present capacity is {soh}% of design: the battery is in good shape, and keeping it there is cheaper than recovering it.
advice.heavy_hour_ahead: Hour {hour} is one of your heavy-usage hours by your own record, and the current charge does not comfortably cover it.
advice.high_drain: Consumption is {rate}% per minute, high against your other sessions. Lower brightness and heavy processes, or run the optimizer.
advice.high_soc_habit: Your machine sits above the healthy ceiling about {hours} hours a day, which multiplies calendar wear {multiplier} times against 40%.
advice.in_window: Charge sits inside the healthy window {floor}% to {ceiling}%: the lowest-stress state for daily use.
advice.night_usage: Your record shows night usage (index {score}%) and the current charge is low for a night session.
advice.no_control_path: This hardware exposes no charge-limit path. The current mode is monitoring and alerts, and there are specific remediation steps for your machine.

diag.finding.battery_absent_flag: The hardware reports the battery as absent (present=0) while still exposing a slot. That is the signature of an electrically disconnected or bad-contact pack.
diag.finding.battery_not_detected: The system sees no battery at all. On a portable machine that means the battery is disconnected, failed, or disabled in BIOS, not merely empty.
diag.finding.capacity_implausible: Full capacity equals design capacity exactly while charge reads zero: these are placeholder values the hardware shows when it loses communication with the pack, so no health figure can be derived from them.
diag.finding.cycles_unavailable: The hardware does not report a cycle count, so the app estimates equivalent cycles from what was actually discharged.
diag.finding.desktop_no_battery: This is a desktop with no battery. Charge limits are meaningless here, and the app runs in power and thermal monitoring mode only.
diag.finding.driver_not_loaded: {vendor} exposes charge thresholds through the {driver} driver, which is not loaded. Loading it may unlock real control.
diag.finding.ec_not_reporting: A battery is present but the embedded controller returns no valid measurement: zero charge, zero voltage, zero current, state "{status}". That is failed cells or a stalled controller, not an empty battery.
diag.finding.firmware_only_control: {vendor} keeps the charge limit in BIOS and does not expose it to the operating system. No in-OS application can set it on this model.
diag.finding.mains_only_operation: The machine runs on mains with no usable battery. Advice shifts to hardware and thermal protection instead of charge limits.
diag.finding.no_threshold_path: This hardware exposes no charge-threshold path. Effective mode: monitoring and alerts.
diag.finding.source_disagreement: Sources disagree: psutil={psutil}, sysfs={sysfs}, upower={upower}. The gap is in the middle layer, not in the battery.
diag.finding.sysfs_timeout: {count} hardware reads exceeded the timeout ({names}). Monitoring continues by skipping those paths, but values may lag.
diag.finding.temp_unavailable: This hardware does not expose battery temperature, so calculations use a declared assumption of 25 degrees.
diag.finding.threshold_path_available: A charge-threshold path exists and can be verified by reading it back after writing.
diag.grade.degraded: Reduced: measurement works, control not owned by the OS
diag.grade.impaired: Unstable: some readings cannot be trusted
diag.grade.ok: Sound: measurements complete and control available
diag.grade.unmeasurable: Unmeasurable: the battery does not report or is absent
diag.no_findings: No findings: the power subsystem reads correctly
diag.remedy.assume_temp: For a tighter wear estimate, run the machine somewhere cooler and watch the system thermal zones in the raw table.
diag.remedy.check_bios_battery: Enter BIOS and check whether the battery appears on the power information page; if it does not, the fault is below the operating system.
diag.remedy.cycles_estimate: Use the equivalent-cycles figure in the analysis area instead of the missing cycle count.
diag.remedy.desktop_mode: Keep alerts on temperature and load only, and ignore charge-limit advice.
diag.remedy.ignore_soh: Ignore any health figure shown for this pack: it comes from placeholder values, not measurement.
diag.remedy.kernel_update: A newer kernel adds support for newer hardware; check the supported hardware list before upgrading.
diag.remedy.load_driver: Load the driver temporarily with modprobe; if thresholds appear, add it to automatic loading.
diag.remedy.mains_only_guidance: Keep the machine on mains in a well-ventilated place and watch temperature: heat is the only active wear factor without a battery.
diag.remedy.notify_mode: The app stays useful without control: it watches temperature and load and warns before limits are crossed once a healthy pack is installed.
diag.remedy.power_cycle_ec: Reset the embedded controller: power off, remove charger and battery if possible, hold the power button for 20 seconds, then reassemble.
diag.remedy.replace_cells: Zero voltage with the pack installed effectively means the cells are finished; replacement is the only known fix for this state.
diag.remedy.reseat_battery: Power off, unplug, reseat the battery, then boot on battery alone without the charger and watch for any response.
diag.remedy.trust_sysfs: Trust the sysfs reading when sources disagree: it sits closest to the hardware while other layers cache.

remedy.asus.driver: Make sure the asus_wmi driver is loaded; it is what exposes the charge ceiling on ASUS machines.
remedy.asus.reset_on_reboot: Some ASUS machines reset the ceiling to 100% on every power cycle, so it must be reapplied at startup.
remedy.dell.bios: Some Dell models expose the setting in BIOS under Power Management as Battery Charge Configuration.
remedy.dell.cctk: Install Dell Command Configure and set the custom charge behaviour from its tool.
remedy.generic.bios_hint: Look through BIOS setup for Battery Care, Battery Health, or Charge Threshold; some vendors put the limit only there.
remedy.generic.check_vendor_list: Check the supported hardware list in the TLP documentation: hardware not listed there does not expose charge thresholds to the operating system.
remedy.generic.notify_mode: Even with no control path the app stays useful: it measures stress, computes projected wear, and warns you before the ceiling is passed or the charge drops critically.
remedy.hp.bios: Reboot and press F10 for BIOS setup, then Advanced, then Power Management Options, and set Battery Health Manager to "Maximize my battery health". That caps charging near 80% in the hardware itself.
remedy.hp.cmsl: On Windows the same setting can be applied from PowerShell after installing the HP Client Management Script Library, with administrator rights and possibly a BIOS password.
remedy.lenovo.conservation: Once the thresholds appear they can be set through TLP or directly from this app.
remedy.lenovo.driver: Make sure the thinkpad_acpi driver is loaded; it is what exposes charge thresholds to the operating system on ThinkPads.
